question: What alternative measurements may govern the extent reaching the middle leaf?
premises: The middle leaf is the reference point
Extent may be measured by three parts
Extent may alternatively be measured by half
inference: The reach to the middle leaf admits either a three-part or a half measure.
uncertainties: Exact unit of the three-part or half measure is not specified
plain_english: It may reach the middle leaf by three parts, or alternatively by half.
